Mayor Allison began the meeting at 7:00pm. Allison introduced everyone and invited all in attendance to stand for the Pledge of Allegiance. Ms. Grimsley spoke of her concerns about the Boundary Line adjustments. Ms. Owens spoke to the Council about her concerns regarding the Data Center. Ms. Owens stated that she was not a Town of Remington resident but lives just outside of the town limits but is active in Town events and was concerned about being heard. Council member Heflin stated what the Council is responsible for and that it is for the Town of Remington and what is within its limits but considers the concerns of surrounding citizens Citizens’ time closed at 7:14 Website Use Policy: Council member Tiemens presented proposed provisions of the Website Use Policy regarding public comments and the submission of content through the Town’s website. The council discussed the proposed provisions, including the ability for individuals to submit comments and provide feedback. The Council agreed to consider the policy for a vote at the next regular Council meeting. Ellerslie Farm: Town Administrator Rachael Brinson reported that the Council had previously approved obtaining a review of the hydrogeological report. Mrs. Brinson stated that the official report had been received and requested direction regarding Hydrogeological LLC conduct an independent review. Stormwater Flood Study Draft: The Council reviewed the Virginia Department of Transportation report regarding the proposed installation of a stormwater drainage pipe on Franklin Street. The Council discussed existing concerns throughout the Town and the potential need to a comprehensive drainage study to identify and address stormwater issues in other areas. Public Works Trailer: Town Administrator Rachael Brinson reported that the Public Works Department needed a replacement trailer due to mechanical issues with the existing trailer, including problems with the hydraulic system, and an inoperable gate. Council member Heflin presented three quotes for a replacement trailer. Council member Tiffany suggested going with a local dealer, stating that the dealer will also provide service for the trailer. Council member Tiffany motioned to accept the quote for the local company and to not exceed $9,000.00. Council member Loving seconded the motion. Motion carried Ayes: Heflin, Loving, Tiemens, Tiffany Nyes: 0 Abstain: Absent: Moxley, Schulz Council member Tiffany motioned to adjourn the meeting with no further business to address.
